context: An elderly couple notices a strange change in the neighborhood
purpose: Teach: 抱か/疑っ/なにやら/至ら/気がつく/引き出す/種々/大人気

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: なあ、最近この町、なにやら様子が変だと思わないか？
lines.en: Hey, lately this town feels somewhat strange, don't you think?
lines.style: Slow, gravelly old-man tone, slightly puzzled and contemplative.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 私も最初は疑っていたんだけど、駅前の古いお店が突然大人気のカフェに変わってたのよ。
lines.en: I doubted it at first too, but the old shop by the station suddenly became a hugely popular cafe.
lines.style: Warm grandmotherly voice, mildly astonished and gossipy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほう、若い者がぞろぞろ歩いてるのを見て、わしも不安を抱かずにはいられんかったよ。
lines.en: Oh, seeing all those young people walking around, I couldn't help feeling uneasy myself.
lines.style: Deep, slightly worried old-man delivery with a sigh.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 公園のベンチに座ってたら、ふと気がつくと知らない顔ばかりでねえ。
lines.en: While sitting on the park bench, before I knew it the faces around were all strangers.
lines.style: Soft, reflective grandmother voice with quiet wistfulness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 町内会でも種々の苦情が出ているらしい。ゴミ出しの時間から駐車まで、至らない点が多いと。
lines.en: Apparently various complaints have come up at the neighborhood meeting too, from trash hours to parking issues.
lines.style: Measured, slightly grumpy old-man tone listing many concerns.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昨日なんて銀行でお金を引き出すのに、長い列ができていたわ。昔はガラガラだったのに。
lines.en: Yesterday there was even a long line just to withdraw money at the bank. It used to be empty.
lines.style: Surprised, slightly indignant grandmotherly voice with disbelief.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うむ。変わるのは仕方ないが、昔ながらの落ち着きも少しは残してほしいもんだなあ。
lines.en: Well, change is unavoidable, but I do wish a bit of the old calm would remain.
lines.style: Resigned, nostalgic old-man tone trailing into a gentle sigh.
